blocks.en: Time Synchronisation
Taking time synchronisation into consideration, the general principle of 'الحال' is to {{ruling|synchronise in time with the primary action}} mentioned the sentence.

When the 'الحال' is a 'اسم' ('مشتق', 'مصدر', 'جامد'), a 'شبه الجملة', a 'جملة فعلية' (with a 'مضارع' verb) or a 'جملة اسمية', then, {{condition|in the absence of an external factor indicating future tense}}, the 'الحال' will {{ruling|synchronise in time with the primary action}}.
This is because, all of the above can be used to express the {{ruling|present tense}}.
When using a 'الحال' which signifies the present tense, it will signify {{ruling|the present tense of the primary action}}.

If {{condition|the primary action is in the past tense and the 'الحال' is a 'مضارع' verb}} for instance, then the 'مضارع' verb will express {{ruling|the present tense of the past tense of the primary action}}.
Lets look at a few examples to understand this better.
Time Synchronisation: Examples
I recited the Qur'an whilst in the state of wudhu
I am reciting/will recite the Qur'an whilst in the state of wudhu.
Zaid ate whilst in the state of being at home
Zaid is eating/will eat whilst in the state of being at home
Bakr travelled whilst he was standing
Bakr is travelling/will travel whilst he is/will be standing
I came whilst the sun was rising
I am coming/will come whilst the sun is/will be rising

{{condition|If the 'الحال' is in the past tense}}, then the past tense 'الحال' will signify upon {{ruling|the past tense of the primary action}} whether that action is in the past, present or future tense.
Bakr travelled whilst he had just eaten.
Bakr is/will travel whilst he has/will just have eaten

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: Timeline under يُسَافر بَكْرٌ with three bands: Future Tense of the Action (empty), Action Tense (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action (أَكَلَ crossed ✘, قَدْ ticked ✓: whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.en: It is {{ruling|necessary}} that a 'قَدْ', for '{{term|تقريب}}', is brought before the 'ماضي' verb to express close proximity, to make it close as possible to the 'Action Tense' in an attempt to almost make it sync. Although total synchronisation has not been achieved, it has come close enough for the ruling of 'الحال' to be applicable.
If, {{condition|due to an external factor, the 'الحال' is understood to be in the future tense}}, then such a 'الحال' is known as a '{{term|الحال المُقَدَّرَة}}' a decreed or circumstantial 'الحال'.
Bakr is traveling whilst he is destined to reach Makkah tomorrow.
Zaid is studying whilst destined to be an Alim

In such scenarios, the 'الحال' is in the meaning of '{{term|مُقَدَّرًا}}', 'being destined'. The 'الحال', 'مُقَدَّرًا' is understood to be {{ruling|in sync with the 'Action tense'}}, This means the 'ذو الحال', in its current state, is in the state of 'being destined' with something. So, in S6a, Bakr's current state is that 'He is destined' to reach Makkah tomorrow. And in S6b, Zaid's current state is that 'He is destined' to becoming an Alim.
So, if we look at S6a with the 'الحال المُقَدَّرَة' and other possible tenses the sentence would be as follows: 'Bakr is traveling…'

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا / يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: Timeline under يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: Future Tense of the Action (مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا, whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.), Action Tense greyed (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action greyed (قَدْ أَكَلَ, whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.ar: {{example|يُسَافر بَكْرٌ مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا}}
blocks.en: Bakr is traveling… whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.
The actual 'الحال' is assumed to be 'مُقَدَّرًا', an '{{term|اسم المفعول}}' which is {{ruling|in sync with the 'Action tense'}}, and will also {{ruling|correlate with the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}}.

blocks.ar: {{example|يُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا الۡأَنۡهٰرُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا}} (المجادلة ٢٢)
blocks.en: He will enter them into gardens beneath which rivers flow whilst they will reside therein forever (Al-Mujadalah 22)
So, if we look at S6b with the 'الحال المُقَدَّرَة' and other possible tenses the sentence would be as follows: 'Bakr is traveling…'

blocks.caption: يُسَافر بَكْرٌ: مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا / يَأْكُلُ / قَدْ أَكَلَ
blocks.caption_en: The same timeline as the previous page, repeated as printed: Future Tense of the Action (مُقَدَّرًا بِأن يَصِلَ مَكَّةَ غَدًا, whilst he is to reach Makkah tomorrow.), Action Tense greyed (يَأْكُلُ, whilst eating.), Past Tense of the Action greyed (قَدْ أَكَلَ, whilst he had just eaten.)

blocks.en: The actual 'الحال' is assumed to be 'مُقَدَّرًا', an '{{term|اسم المفعول}}' which is in sync with the 'Action tense', and will also {{ruling|correlate with the 'ذو الحال' in N/G}}.

blocks.ar: {{example|يُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِهَا الۡأَنۡهٰرُ مُقَدَّرِيْنَ بِالْخُلُوْدِ فِيهَا}}
blocks.en: He will enter them into gardens beneath which rivers flow whilst they are destined with everlasting residence therein.
Sequence

In regards to the sequence of the 'الحال', it is {{ruling|permissible}} for the 'الحال' to {{ruling|precede the 'ذو الحال'}}. It is also permissible for the 'الحال' to {{ruling|precede its governor}}, the primary action verb.

blocks.caption: تركيب: جَاءَ رَاكبًا زَيْدٌ / رَاكِبًا جَاءَ زَيْدٌ
blocks.caption_en: Two tarkeeb trees, 16a and 16b, each labelled word by word (فعل, حال, ذو الحال). In 16a a line joins حال and ذو الحال and is labelled فاعل; in 16b one line runs under all three words with فاعل beneath it and a tick dropping from فعل. In both the whole is labelled جملة فعلية خبرية.

blocks.en: Zaid came whilst riding.
Zaid came whilst riding.
In 16a, 'رَاكِبًا' is 'الحال' and it has {{ruling|preceded the 'ذو الحال'}}. In 16b, 'رَاكِبًا' is 'الحال' and it has {{ruling|preceded the 'ذو الحال' and its governor 'جَاءَ'}}.
